newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart to add 180-185 new stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart to add 180-185 new stores in FY97.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc said Tuesday its plans for the new fiscal year include 50 new domestic discount stores, 30 to 35 new international discount stores and 100 new domestic Supercenters.
About 70 of the Supercenters will come from relocations or expansions of existing discount stores, the company said. It said it also plans to open five to 10 new clubs.
The plans represent about 20 million square feet of additional domestic retail space, the company said.
International stores will open in Argentina, Brazil, Canada, China, Indonesia, Mexico and Puerto Rico, the company said.
The company's fiscal year begins February 1, 1997. Company spokesman Jay Fitzsimmons said the stores would be open by the end of the fiscal year on January 31, 1998.

As of September 30, Wal-Mart had 1,946 Wal-Mart stores, 324 Supercenters, 436 Sam's Clubs, four Argentina units, five Brazilian units, 135 Canadian Wal-Mart stores, two China stores, one Indonesian Supercenter, 138 Mexican units, and 11 Puerto Rico units.
